source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The accessible accepted-version abstract describes sufficient graphical conditions for micro total effects in latent-confounded SCGs and a do-free expression, not a completeness claim.
The paper distinguishes macro from micro queries and states soundness and completeness of do-calculus for macro total effects in SCGs.
The paper gives algorithms and graphical characterizations for identifiable and non-identifiable causal queries in fixed graphical models.
The paper takes a PAG representing a Markov-equivalence class as input and proves its conditional-effect identification algorithm and calculus sound and complete.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Make \(\mathcal A\) a fixed input of \(\mathfrak M(H,L,\mathcal A)\), UID, TID, and every cylinder language; alternatively provide a canonical common alphabet/embedding and define equality of observed laws on it.

Add one worked small-instance transducer trace that explicitly outputs either a common \(F\) or a lag-switch certificate and gives the resulting finite state/radius bound, rather than only specifying the collision SCM pair.

For the Assaad strict-extension theorem, name a second latent-confounded micro-effect comparator or cite an explicit open completeness statement and prove the new class strictly contains its published domain.

recommended_next_step: Revise the model/query signatures to fix the observed alphabet before Stage 0; then retain the normal-form OEQ as the flagship algorithmic-identifiability kernel.
